verdicts.claim: on all four organs, Ψ⁷’s Brier score on unseen cases is lower than Ψ⁰’s — the organism knows its own correctness better than its base rate
verdicts.saw: shopper 0.164887 → 0.123676; triage 0.016628 → 0.015114; water 0.178107 → 0.158163; crop 0.221149 → 0.201745 (Brier on unseen cases, base rate → Ψ⁷)

verdicts.claim: it settles: on all four organs the last step moves Ψ by less than 0.01 on average, and by less than the second step did
a spiral, not a one-step jump: on at least three organs, the unseen-case Brier score improves at two or more of the seven refinements
